messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx/timeout rate on service=api-gateway (eu region) sustained for 12m. Pager -> @taylor at 1800012345

 taylor: got it, I'm on pager. starting quick blast radius check and log tail for envoy clusters.

 sre_rene: I see spikes around 18:40 UTC on /v1/events and /v1/submit. errors are 502/504. latency p95 for upstream calls jumped to 1.2s. pulling provider connection stats.

 olivia: customer-impact check: API errors affecting webhook deliveries and some long-polling clients. estimate ~1.8% errors on EU traffic in last 10m, higher for premium webhook customers. filing CS heads-up.

 pm_ishaan: tagging affected customers list now. will prepare short advisory if we need to escalate.

 monitoring-bot: Datadog alert DG-50001 triggered: api.gateway.euw.5xx_rate > 0.6% for 10m. View: https://app.datadog/integration/alerts/DG-50001

 devops_li: hypothesis: upstream provider pool B is dropping keepalives, causing connection resets -> envoy returns 502/504. Also saw increased retry count.

 taylor: mitigation options: (A) increase proxy upstream timeout from 1.5s -> 5s in euw cluster, (B) temporarily failover traffic from provider-pool-B to pool-A, (C) apply a temporary suppression on low-volume route alerts to reduce noise while we monitor.

 sre_rene: prefer B + C. increasing timeouts helps but may hide underlying provider slowness. failover is quick if pool-A healthy. I'll run health check script: `./scripts/check_provider_health --pool pool-A,pool-B --region eu-west-1`

 taylor: running failover to pool-A for 30% of requests to reduce load on pool-B. command: `kubectl apply -f routing/partial-failover-euw.yaml`

 monitoring-bot: deploy-bot: routing change applied in eu-west-1 (canary 30%).

 olivia: after canary, 5xx dropped from 1.9% -> 0.8% in 7m. webhook retries backfilling starting. still seeing intermittent 504 tails.

 taylor: opening provider ticket PKG-9002 with provider (pool-B) and attaching TCP resets + envoy logs. provider replied acknowledging packet-loss pattern in eu-west and investigating.

 sre_rene: temporary alert tuning steps we should do now:
 - mute DG-50001 for 20m to avoid duplicate paging while we observe
 - create dashboard tile: per-route 5xx heatmap + upstream RTT (dash id dash-2102)
 - adjust alert query to be traffic-weighted and ignore routes with <500rpm

 olivia: doing the mute now. muted DG-50001 for 20m. also creating slack alert to post summary to #incidents.

 monitoring-bot: DG-50001 muted by olivia until 1800013545.

 taylor: rolling timeout bump as a fallback: `envoy cluster config: lb_policy: ROUND_ROBIN, upstream_timeout_ms: 5000` applied to euw proxies (rolling update).

 devops_li: note: longer upstream timeout will increase request tail; add a circuit-breaker on slow requests if we see resource pressure. Also add retry budget for critical endpoints.

 olivia: quick smoke: p50/p95 latency back to normal but p99 still elevated slightly. 5xx now ~0.5% and trending down.

 pm_ishaan: good, I'm sending a short customer note: "We observed transient upstream connectivity issues impacting EU API calls. We've routed traffic away from the affected provider pool and applied temporary mitigations. Monitoring for recovery; full postmortem to follow."

 taylor: handoff note: I need to step out in 45m. @devops_li please take pass if issues continue. state: partial failover to pool-A (30%), timeout bump to 5s in eu-west, DG-50001 muted for 20m, provider ticket PKG-9002 open, dashboards: dash-2102 created.

 devops_li: I can take the remainder at 1800014200. leave runbook summary here.

 sre_rene: follow-ups for post-incident:
 - revert or tune timeout bump after provider confirms fix (or after 6h assessment)
 - change DG-50001 to a rate-relative alert that ignores endpoints <500rpm and includes provider-pool dimension
 - build provider health dashboard with TCP resets, retry counts, and connection pool fullness
 - create automated failover runbook: if provider-pool error-rate > 1% for 5m, shift 50% traffic to alternate pool and mute noisy alerts during shift

 olivia: created SRE ticket SRE-1309 "Provider failover + alert tuning" and assigned to @sre_rene. added initial timeline and links to logs/dash-2102.

 monitoring-bot: Note: DG-50001 will auto-unmute at 1800013545 unless extended.

 taylor: status after 35m: error-rate steady at 0.45%, provider pool-B showing reduced throughput but still some TCP resets. leaving watch; will await provider update. :white_check_mark:

 devops_li: taking handoff now. checklist: provider ticket PKG-9002, dash-2102, mute on DG-50001, routing canary manifest in routing/partial-failover-euw.yaml, runbook steps. escalate to @sre_rene and @olivia if errors climb above 1%.

 olivia: schedule: we should do a 30-45m incident review tomorrow 09:00 UTC to pick thresholds and finalize runbook changes. pm_ishaan will coordinate customer comms postmortem.

 pm_ishaan: I'll draft timeline and RCA outline in SRE-1309. pls add any missing query snippets and logs.

 incident-bot: Incident thread auto-closed (monitoring stable). Re-open if DG-50001 or related alerts fire.
